Receiver discovery includes JmDNS 3.6.5, Apache License 2.0.
Upstream: https://github.com/jmdns/jmdns
Commit: 2570b99a40ccaa3d3ef8352c20f25cca0ca3d477

The upstream LICENSE and NOTICE.txt are preserved in vendor/jmdns.
prepare_jmdns.py verifies the original Java source digest and reproduces the
Java 7 / Android API17 source changes recorded in vendor/jmdns/api17.patch.
The multi-interface JmmDNS engine is excluded. ReceiverDiscovery explicitly
selects the actual control listener's local address.
Java 8 library calls and language constructs are replaced by Java 7 equivalents;
SLF4J calls use the local java.util.logging adapter. No SLF4J code is included.
provenance.json records original and ported source digests.
The address-bound send socket also has an owned receive worker. On Unix its
specific bind otherwise captures unicast queries without dispatching them to
the wildcard receive worker. Both workers are closed with the engine.
Legacy unicast response TTLs are capped at ten seconds per RFC 6762 section 6.7.

The compatibility adapter is Apache-2.0. The receiver integration and test
fixtures are GPL-3.0-only as marked in their source files.
Compilation alone does not establish Android runtime or phone compatibility.
